meta.title: Realman Studio
meta.description: Live-action cinematic Seedance short-drama production: bundles the realman skill (six pillars, dialogue red-line, clean prompt body), turns a story into script, asset images and 15-second storyboards, runs mechanical pre-flight checks (lip-sync declaration / prompt purity / timeline format), renders on the Jimeng canvas through the official CLI with cross-episode video hand-off, and assembles the episodes. Images use seedream_5.5 (2K, measured ~6 credits each), video uses seedance_2.5_flash (480p, native speech + lip sync, ~105 credits per 15s); install and sign in to the official Jimeng CLI first. The sidebar workbench has overview, projects, generation history (credits/outputs/failures), new-drama form, and a workflow guide with install steps, the image-generation flow and the pricing table.
